description: This file implements a generic maximum heap data structure (MaxHeap) in C# optimized for priority queue operations using an array-backed d-ary heap (quaternary). It includes classes for heap elements, specifically tailored for use with Orleans placement algorithms, with support for dynamic priority updates and enumeration.

classes.name: CandidateVertexHeapElement
classes.description: A heap element representing a candidate vertex with associated transfer score and location, implementing the IHeapElement interface.

classes.name: IHeapElement<TElement>
classes.description: Interface defining properties and methods for heap elements, including comparison logic and heap index management.

classes.name: MaxHeap<TElement>
classes.description: A generic, array-based, quaternary max-heap data structure supporting operations such as insertion, removal, heapify, and priority updates.

methods.name: CandidateVertexHeapElement
methods.description: Constructor initializing a heap element with a CandidateVertex value.

methods.name: OnDecreaseElementPriority
methods.description: Adjusts heap after an element's priority decreases, moving it down as needed.

methods.name: OnIncreaseElementPriority
methods.description: Adjusts heap after an element's priority increases, moving it up as needed.

methods.name: Heapify
methods.description: Transforms an unordered list into a valid heap structure.

methods.name: MoveUp
methods.description: Restores heap property by moving a node up the tree.

methods.name: MoveDown
methods.description: Restores heap property by moving a node down the tree.
